title: bundle.json: manifest at the root of the Ship tooling bundle
description: Written by FleetLedger when it packs ship/ into a bundle (W3, and `ship-fleet update`); read by the seed bootstrap and `ship-ctl converge` (W4, W5). See contracts/seed.md.

tooling_version.description: versions.toml [shipshape].tooling at pack time; also the release folder name.

commit.description: Git commit the bundle was packed from.

dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes.
